plugins.name: r-lsp
plugins.description: R language server for Claude Code with renv support. Tidyverse-aware bug diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, find-references, workspace symbols and call hierarchy for R, R Markdown and Quarto files; a column-name check for tidyverse code with a schema cache for S3 and loader data, following data written by one script and read by another, and targets pipelines; a static call map with diff impact and test reach; a data map of sources, columns, lineage and the data side of a diff; checks after every change to an R file, through Edit, Write, Bash or a subagent; dormant in directories without R code.
